description: This file defines a custom Filesystem class that extends Symfony's Filesystem component, adding a method to write content to a file while ensuring the directory exists and handling errors.

classes.name: Filesystem
classes.description: A custom extension of Symfony's Filesystem class with an added dumpFile method that writes content to a specified file, creating directories as needed, and handling errors.

methods.name: dumpFile
methods.description: Writes content to a file, creating necessary directories, and throws an IOException if the write fails.
